questions.question: The second number in the given number pairs is obtained by performing certain mathematical operations(s) on the first number. The same operation(s) are followed in all the number pairs except one. Find that odd number pair.
If 11 October 1965 is Monday, then what will be the day of the week on 15 July 1973?
questions.solution:
Given : 11 October 1965 was Monday

Explanation :

The number of odd days from 11 October 1965 to 15 July 1973 :

 
 

 Year
 Period
 Calculation
 Odd days
 
 

 1965
 11 October 1965 - 31 December 1965
 20 October + 30 November + 31 December = 81 days
 81 ÷ 7 = 4
 
 

 1966 - 1972
 Full years (5 Ordinary years + 2 Leap years)
 (1 odd day × 5 Ordinary years) + (2 odd days × 2 Leap years) = 9 odd days
 9 ÷ 7 = 2
 
 

 1973
 1st January 1973 - 15 July 1973
 31 January + 28 February + 31 March + 30 April + 31 May + 30 June + 15 July = 196 days
 196 ÷ 7 = 0
 
 

 Total odd days
 **6**
 
 

∴ The number of odd days from 11 October 1965 to 15 July 1973 ⇒ 6

⇒So, One odd day get added to Saturday because day asked in future.

∴ Sunday was the day of the week on the 15 July 1973.

Hence, "Sunday" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means 'A is the mother of B'

A - B means 'A is the husband of B'

A × B means 'A is the father of B'

A ÷ B means 'A is the sister of B'

Based on the above, how is D related to H if 'D × E - F + G ÷ H'?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given:

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 ÷
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Husband

 
 
 
Father

 
 Sister
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

Statement given: D × E - F + G ÷ H

So,

 
• D × E → D is the father of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19ade3757095ccf0249bb5fbeb01e109f959e03367f7bd18a9de1d08e2c645ec.png] 

 
• E - F → E is the husband of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/523734a4d1c9d8333fb0a17c3f122b3dc08ea9e9683a72160477f0ffc169615f.png] 

 
• F + G → F is the mother of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e4712f361f3ab15e57aada8a2e25a53503fe6f1c2cf2772008b584ba0ec2280.png] 

 
• G ÷ H → G is the sister of H.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c9f7fc5b7714c54dacee64f4e314d411045180172100efc76d5e9f23d08c4a7.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree D is the maternal grandfather i.e father's father of H.

Hence, "**Father's father**" is the correct answer.
